protocol.split_unit: Exact transfer/vote-table hash; all stance variants stay together; zero-transfer training anchor.
protocol.selection: Minimum validation RMSE; rank/seed selection never uses test; no postselection refit.
protocol.baseline_offset: Exact zero-transfer result under each declared stance is known input; learned target is its seat change.
protocol.holdout_scope: In-design interpolation; amount/direction/party/district levels all observed during training. Not new-election or out-of-grid generalization.
protocol.duplicate_outputs: Different full district vote tables can produce identical national seat outcomes; split prevents duplicate vote tables, not identical outcome values.

train.threshold_limitation: A one-class subset cannot establish threshold discrimination, even with zero disagreements.

near_threshold.definition: Exact nonreject_min in [171,179]; selected using exact targets after split.

train.interpretation: Raw continuous reconstruction; no rounding/clipping and no replacement for exact threshold calculation.
